newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Temperatures to rise in Brazil coffee areas -Somar.
newsitem.headline: Temperatures to rise in Brazil coffee areas -Somar.

text.p: Much sun and warmer temperatures are forecast for Brazil's coffee regions in the coming days, local meteorologists Somar said in a weather update on Thursday.

Minimum temperatures in the last 24 hours ranged between five degrees Celsius in Pocos de Caldas, Minas Gerais, traditionally Brazil's coldest coffee region and 15 degrees Celsius in southern Sao Paulo state, Somar said.
According to the latest models, any cold fronts and polar air masses are passing through only the far south of the country, leading to rise in temperatures in the coffee belt which is further north.
On August 18, the next high pressure system with an intensity of 1,030 millibars will start to move towards Brazil from the south Pacific.
It should reach Rio Grande do Sul state and Uruguay on August 20 but then should head out to the Atlantic, Somar said.
